text:
rachel: Quick idea for safer config rollouts: a 'sparing rollout' primitive that applies changes but constrains both route share and quota headroom for a short window. aim: surface regressions without letting a bad config consume unlimited capacity.

ben: can you show the lifecycle?

rachel: lifecycle: POST /configs/commit?sparing=true with body {commit_id, window_mins, share_pct, quota_headroom_pct, redaction}. system marks affected routes as sparing_active and enforces two controls: (1) route share limiting: only share_pct of matching traffic is routed to the new config; (2) quota headroom: we reserve quota_headroom_pct of original quota to be preserved, so bursty increases get throttled.

ilyas: how does share_pct interact with existing sampling/cohort logic?

rachel: share_pct composes with cohorts by intersection; default cohort=global. sampling seed stored for idempotency. we return a sparing_id so UI and automation can fetch the same telemetry.

ben: telemetry needs: per-route p95/p99, error delta, quota_utilization_delta, and "sparing_truncation" metric (how often requests were rejected due to headroom). include cost delta per 1k tokens.

marta: add a compact verdict: score 0-100 plus recommended action: promote|hold|rollback. console shows color + reason.

ops-bot: checklist: new RBAC scopes (configs.commit.sparing, configs.sparing.action), telemetry schema (sparing_v1), audit hooks, and retention policy for sparing reports (14d default).

ilyas: privacy: default redaction=mask. also require operator confirmation if redaction=none.

ben: edge case: multi-route commit where some routes exceed headroom while others pass. policy?

rachel: implement per-route evaluation. by default we hold global promotion if any critical route fails, but we expose per-route promote buttons in console for manual partial promotion. orgs can opt into auto-split-promote for tolerant use-cases.

ilyas: idempotency and replay: sparing_id = HMAC(commit_id + seed). allow re-run of the same sparing window against a new baseline with rerun_id but disallow concurrent sparing windows for the same commit_id to prevent confusion.

ben: automation: allow args for auto-promote thresholds in commit payload: {promote_if: {p95_ms_delta_lt: 5, error_delta_pp_lt: 0.2}}. default = manual.

marta: UI needs a tight diff view showing which routes change quotas or variants, plus a tiny live sparkline for p95 and truncation. also a link to raw signed report.

rachel: testing: add unit tests for enforcement logic and an e2e harness that simulates traffic patterns and quota pressure. also add a chaos test that flips quota_headroom to ensure truncation fires.

ops-bot: note: schedule a short oncall drill after rollout to validate alerting for sparing_truncation > 1% and auto-pause behavior.

ben: sounds good. can you draft RFC?

rachel: will write RFC + PoC next week. thanks all. :rocket:
